senses.gloss: m. (φιλόσοφος) philosopher, one living a life of speculation and self-denial, monk (v. Gr. Dict. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:13">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חד פ׳ שאל וכ׳</he> (not <he>פיוס …</he>) a certain philosopher (Christian?) asked &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:5:4">Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 5:3">Treat. Der. Er. ch. V</cite> (v. Brüll, Jahrb. 1879, p. 41).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:11">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>פ׳ אחד שאל וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>פילסופי</he>, corr. acc.) a philosopher asked R. G.; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:18">Ab. Zar. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>פלוספוס</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פִּילוֹסוֹפִים</he>, <he>פִּילוֹסוֹפִין</he>, <he>(פְּלוֹ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:18">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:3">Tosef. ib. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:7">VII</cite>), 7.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:20">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>לא עמדו פ׳ בעולם וכ׳</he> no philosophers ever arose as wise as Balaam &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:7">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>ישבו פ׳ וחשבו</he> (= <cite ref="O00394"><he>סופיסטיס</he></cite>) accountants sat down and calculated; a. fr.
